title: 288 Jackson Ave Oshawa Open House Video Tour
description:
Welcome to 288 Jackson Avenue, a charming bungalow with some great updated features, and close to numerous amenities within Central Oshawa. 

This home features a brick and stone exterior; ample driveway parking; concrete steps and a covered front entrance; a front yard with perennial beds; as well as a large fenced-in backyard that has an extensive wooden deck with gazebo, an outdoor storage shed, and a fire pit. This home has been freshly painted throughout, and also features a newer furnace with NEST thermostat.

The main level opens into a ceramic-tiled entrance hallway, off of which are two bedrooms finished with crown moldings and hardwood floors. The first (and larger) of these bedrooms is complete with a mirrored door double closet, while the second bedroom has a walk-in closet - and the south-facing windows in both rooms have California shutters for light control and privacy.

There is also a coat closet and access to the lower level off the hallway, as well as an updated 4-pc washroom with a ceramic-tiled floor and bath area, and a vanity area with plenty of toiletry and linen storage.

The hallway leads into the two principal spaces - a large eat-in kitchen and a family/living room - with a wall pass-thru maintaining an openness between the two rooms. The family room overlooks the backyard, and the kitchen features a cozy breakfast area, ample cabinetry and counter space, as well as appliances. California shutters are found on the two main windows, while the back door walk-out has between the glass blinds for privacy.

The lower level has a separate side door access, and this level has carpeting throughout its huge recreation area, as well a separate laundry and mechanical room that is partially carpeted and includes washer and dryer.

This home is within the catchment areas of Clara Hughes Public School, St. Hedwig Catholic Elementary School, Msgr. John Pereyma Catholic Secondary School, and Eastdale C. V. I.; as well as David Bouchard Public School, St. Thomas Aquinas Catholic Elementary School, R. S. McLaughlin C. V. I., and Father Leo J. Austin Catholic Secondary School for their French Immersion Programs.

Chopin Park is just around the corner, and within walking distance is public transit, retail establishments for everyday shopping essentials and services, restaurants, as well as places of worship. Other nearby amenities include the Oshawa Centre Shopping Mall, the SmartCentres Oshawa Plaza, the Robert McLaughlin gallery, the Oshawa Valley Botanical Gardens, the Oshawa Golf and Curling Club, community and recreational facilities, as well as access to Hwy 401 - all which are just short drives away.

For more information, contact Suzanne Jenkins, of Royal LePage Connect Realty, Brokerage, at (416) 708-7301.
author: Open House 24
